reader.decision: Approve the manual ack, prefetch, drain and grace changes. Also ask Billing whether meter.internal dedupes on ref, and make that check a condition for shipping the code change. If a hotfix is needed before the code ships, apply the config-only grace and drain change first.
reader.decision_reason: Acking at delivery is the root cause of the lost jobs, and manual ack with prefetch turns a kill into a redelivery instead of a silent loss. The only new risk is a double bill from a redelivered job, and the Billing team can settle that.

reconstruction.problem: After a deploy, some uploads get no thumbnail and no error. lantern-worker acks each message on delivery (auto_ack=True). On SIGTERM the 60s drain is cut short because terminationGracePeriodSeconds is 20 in values-prod.yaml, so kubelet sends SIGKILL at 14:02:30. pool.submit also swallows exceptions silently.
reconstruction.what_breaks: Threads die mid-render (u-88217, u-88218, u-88219 and u-88221 are named), and jobs sitting unstarted in the pool queue may be lost too. RabbitMQ already acked them, so nothing is redelivered. The upload page shows the placeholder with no error. A crash, an OOM kill or a node loss would lose jobs the same way.
reconstruction.fix: In worker/consume.py, set auto_ack=False and basic_qos(prefetch_count=settings.CONCURRENCY). Submit a wrapper that runs handle, then acks through connection.add_callback_threadsafe. On an exception, log it and basic_nack with requeue=False. In worker/lifecycle.py, drain takes the connection and uses process_data_events(time_limit=0.5) in place of time.sleep(0.5). In values-prod.yaml, set terminationGracePeriodSeconds to 90 and LANTERN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 75. The alternative is config-only (grace period and drain time), which still loses jobs on a crash, an OOM kill or a node loss.
reconstruction.cost: A job can render twice if a kill lands between put_thumbnail and the ack. The S3 overwrite is harmless, but record_usage in billing/client.py sends no idempotency key, so a redelivery could bill twice unless meter.internal dedupes on ref. Billing owns that service, so the repo cannot answer it. The config-only alternative costs no code change but leaves the crash and OOM cases.

follow_up_questions: Does meter.internal dedupe on ref? Billing has to answer this.
Is nack with requeue=False backed by a dead-letter queue? If not, a failed job is dropped, and the message does not say whether a DLQ exists.
reader.closing_answer: Yes, I approve the manual ack, prefetch, drain and grace changes. Yes, ask Billing whether meter.internal dedupes on ref. Ask now, in parallel with the code change, and don't ship until they answer. If they say it doesn't dedupe, add an idempotency key to record_usage. If we need a hotfix before then, ship the config-only change first.
